main_text.head: IN ORATIONES DANIELIS HEINSII, HVGONIS GROTII EPIGRAMMA.
main_text.p: POst dignum Latio pedem cothurno, Post Rossæ teneras amationes, Scriptas carmine, quale Naso, quale Romanus cupetet suum Philetas, Post Flacci cithaam, tubam Maronis, Post tantæ trimetros seueritatis Vt rugas superent Catonianos, Jam Demosthenicæ sitior undæ Linquis Pegaseos, amice, fontes, Regnans eloquio solutiore, Dum nunc ingenii fluentis æstum Libertas tibi Tulliana laxat, Nunc facundia Plinium secuta Constringi studet arctiore gyro, Nunc docti Senecæ refert acumen Densis pagina seminata gemmis. Heinsi, viue diu, diuque de te Certet Suada potens, nouemque Musæ, Quitquid nominibus prioris ævi Æternam potuit parare famam, Hoc in te liceat stuperte solo. Millenis facibus superba nox est: Astrum sufficit vnicum diêi.
main_text.notes: Blue ink stains obscure parts of the lines "stuperte solo", "superba nox" and "vnicum diêi"; readings there are uncertain. Lines 'Post Rossæ' and 'Nunc docti' follow the printed line breaks as they stand. The line "Hoc in te liceat stupere solo" is partly covered; "stuperte" is transcribed as printed and marked uncertain. The word "sufficit" is partly covered by ink and may be read as "sufficit" with some doubt.
